name: Gruul Clans
aliases: the guild which is not one
description: The Gruul Clans are the red-green anarchic guild of Ravnica, a loose affiliation of savage clans of the Rubblebelt and wild places.

description_citations.text: "Gruul Clans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: The Gruul Clans are the red-green anarchic guild of Ravnica, a loose affiliation of savage clans of the Rubblebelt and wild places.

citations.text: "Gruul Clans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: As civilization and the other guilds overran every wild place, the Gruul lost their responsibilities, and the Azorius wrote them out of the law as being outside the Guildpact.

citations.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The clans clashed with other guilds, ravaging the streets while the Orzhov sought to cleanse them, and meeting the Rakdos in battle.

citations.text: "Guildpact", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Durri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Their alliance with Cecilee ended when she refused to return an abandoned Gruul baby to Nikya's clan.

citations.text: "Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Battle for the Ninth, Gideon led a Gruul horde into a square where the Boros fired on them and the Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other.

citations.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark, Domri Rade led the Gruul in a mob rampage through the Tenth District, and after his death the clans regrouped at Skarrg.

citations.text: "Tenth District", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Araithia Shokta persuaded Borborygmos to let go of his grudges, and the Gruul fought in Ravnica's defense against the Phyrexian invasion.

citations.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Afterward the clans occupied ruins and expanded their territory, disrupting rebuilding and clashing with the Boros.

citations.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: After the invasion the clans hold ruins and expanded territory on Ravnica, and a Gruul speaker appears in the most recent stories.

citations.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Dravin deserts after seeing a blazing archon and weeping at the idiocy of war.
timeline.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.

citation.text: Blazing Archon (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Civilization and the other guilds overrun every wild place, stripping the Gruul of their responsibilities and changing them.
timeline.quote: Civilization and the other nine guilds, however, overran every wild place on the plane.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Seen as outside the Guildpact, the Gruul are written out of the law by the Azorius and left exploitable by the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: they were seen as outside of the Guildpact, and the Azorius began to write them out of the law

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ghut Rak plans to bring the guilds down to earth.
timeline.quote: It's time we brought them back down to earth.

citation.text: Crash Landing (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa mocks the Gruul for following Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'

citation.text: Borborygmos (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gruul ravage the streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them.
timeline.quote: Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to "cleanse" them.

citation.text: "Guildpact", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izzet goblin Kaluzax is shot down by Gruul while flying an observosphere to bomb Utvara.
timeline.quote: Kaluzax is attacked by Gruul however and goes down with the ship.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Four Selesnya sentries held off an entire Gruul clan at the Battle of Sumala.
timeline.quote: four Selesnya sentries held off an entire clan of Gruul warriors.

citation.text: Selesnya Sentry (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Domri is dressed in burial garb and the tribe wails as if he had died; Sabast says the boy dies today.
timeline.quote: In one way or another, that boy dies today.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Orphaned on Ravnica, Domri is too small for any Gruul clan to claim him and befriends feral beasts.
timeline.quote: he was too small and wiry for any clan of the Gruul to claim him

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
timeline.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
timeline.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Anza bait the Gruul giant Krokt into wrecking buildings while Gideon sends Anza to tell Dars to get into position.
timeline.quote: Get back to the square, tell Dars that we're coming and to get into position.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads a horde of Gruul into the square, where the Boros fire down on them from rooftops.
timeline.quote: From the rooftops and upper floors, a blaze of Boros magic lit the square with streams of fire that slammed into the Gruul.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Boros charge the Gruul hand to hand.
timeline.quote: Gideon and the Boros rushed from their positions to engage the Gruul hand-to-hand.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Firefist opens its line and the Rakdos pour into the square, where Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros contain them.
timeline.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: In the Gruul market, Ossett catches a child thieving but pays the merchant and lets her go.
timeline.quote: I sigh, then let the child go.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Domri leads the Gruul in a mob rampage to push the guilds into chaos.
timeline.quote: Domri led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Utvara is devastated by a Simic-origin plague worsened by Gruul encroachment and is declared a reclamation zone.
timeline.quote: Utvara was devastated by a Simic -origin plague.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the ruined battlefront the Ghor Clan builds rubble tributes and Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it.
timeline.quote: And just like that, Rage ignites.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat convinces Borborygmos to support the cause.
timeline.quote: Rat convinced the cyclops (who had a soft spot for her) to support their cause.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade leads the Gruul in an effort to tip the world into chaos.
timeline.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Domri Rade leads the Gruul in a mob rampage through the Tenth District.
timeline.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a massive mob rampage through the city streets of the Tenth District, causing destruction and chaos to keep the guilds at each other's throats.

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the clans occupy ruins and expand their territory, disrupting rebuilding and clashing with the Boros.
timeline.quote: Efforts to rebuild Ravnica are constantly and actively disrupted by the Gruul.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ossett goes to the Gruul encampment on the outskirts of the Tenth District on her first assignment.
timeline.quote: Her first assignment as a Wojek counterintelligence agent took her to the outskirts of the Tenth District

citation.text: "Ossett Weslyn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ari survives the War of the Spark and joins the new Gruul guild without Domri Rade.
timeline.quote: Ari survived the War of the Spark

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a favor to Niv-Mizzet, Borborygmos attends the guild summit for the Gruul, costing him respect among his people.
timeline.quote: This cost him much respect and honor amongst his people, for whom cooperation was anathema.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Yore grows, attracting members including the Gruul, and Bougrat feels hopeful.
timeline.quote: As the Cult of Yore grew in numbers, it attracted members from various backgrounds

citation.text: "Bougrat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cecilee builds a vernadi in the Rubblebelt as a healing center and forms a bond with the Gruul.
timeline.quote: she built an outpost of the Conclave called a vernadi

citation.text: "Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned Gruul baby, names him Zi, and refuses to return him to Nikya's clan, ending the Gruul alliance.
timeline.quote: Cecilee adopted the infant to raise as her own

citation.text: "Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Gruul warband attacks and badly damages Kaluzax's observosphere.
timeline.quote: managed to badly damage the vessel

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix becomes lost when Gruul attack Teysa Karlov's lokopede, then reaches the Cauldron with help from Vor Golozar, Agrus Kos and Pivlic.
timeline.quote: she was able to reach the Cauldron and deliver her message

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dars's firecasters blast the arriving Gruul from windows and doorways.
timeline.quote: he had his secret firecasters blast the Gruul from windows and doorways

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Firefist disengages and forms a wall as the Rakdos pour in and tear into the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Dars ordered a knight to sound the trumpet

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros close in, a success.
timeline.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gruul war party meets the Rakdos raiders in battle.
timeline.quote: Durri and the rest of the Gruul war party soon ran into the Rakdos raiders, and a battle quickly followed.

citation.text: "Durri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ferzhin fights Domri Rade, is wounded, and defeats him with a headbutt.
timeline.quote: Despite being wounded by Domri, she defeated him with a headbutt.

citation.text: "Ferzhin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan and his family survive the War of the Spark and join the new Gruul Clan freed from Domri.
timeline.quote: Gan and his family survived the War of the Spark and were part of the new Gruul Clan, freed from Domri's leadership.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the battle with Zomaj Hauc and the Cauldron's destruction, the Husk is granted to the Gruul clans as sovereign territory.
timeline.quote: the Husk was granted to the clans as their sovereign territory

citation.text: "Husk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos attack, and Janik holds his own in the fight.
timeline.quote: He held his own for a while

citation.text: "Janik", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Domri Rade's death at the hands of the Dreadhorde, the Gruul Clans regroup at Skarrg.
timeline.quote: the death of their new guildleader Domri Rade at the hands of the invading Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Araithia Shokta intervenes and convinces Borborygmos to let go of his grudges, allowing the Gruul to band together with the plane's defenders.
timeline.quote: Gan's daughter Araithia Shokta intervened and convinced Borborygmos to let go of his grudges against the other guilds

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorel concedes territory to the Boros and his Gruul clan turns on him; he nearly dies and escapes.
timeline.quote: the clan turned on him. He was nearly killed before escaping.

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hauc explodes a bomb above the Utvara Reclamation Zone, which kills the local Gruul by implosion but creates the Schism instead of exploding.
timeline.quote: The machine killed all the local Gruul with an implosion but didn't explode.

citation.text: "Zomaj Hauc", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
